title: EverList Security Self-Check
method: Free automated battery + internal review, documented honestly. No professional penetration test commissioned yet (scheduled as a gate before real-money operation).
scopes_run: HTTP security headers on representative public endpoints (/, /partner/sla.json, /status)
Dependency vulnerability scan of pinned hub requirements (pip-audit 2.10.1, PYSEC/OSV database, 2026-11-16)
OWASP ZAP 2.16.0 passive spider of everlist.network (read-only, no active scanning against prod)
Install-free Python DAST-lite battery against an isolated hub boot (auth walls, malformed input, injection probes, traversal, CRLF, method misuse, error-leakage discipline)
not_run_yet: Manual penetration test (business-logic / escrow-flow attack paths) - owner-gated budget item, targeted before real-money launch
Dynamic application scanning (OWASP ZAP full scan) - not available in the build environment at scan time; covered partially by header/TLS probes and the internal review
TLS 1.0 client probe (test client no longer supports the protocol; TLS 1.1 explicitly rejected by the server, see below; Caddy defaults disable TLS 1.0/1.1)

tls.hsts: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains on all probed endpoints

security_headers.content_security_policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'

findings.class: libsodium point-validation edge case in atypical use cases (DoS class)
findings.exposure: transitive via cosmpy (Agentverse/chat integration), not the hub money path; zero direct imports in hub code
findings.mitigation: fix upgrade attempted; cosmpy 0.12.2 hard-pins pynacl==1.6.0 - upgrading pynacl alone breaks the dependency tree, so the pin stands and the risk is accepted + monitored; re-scan on cosmpy update

findings.class: Minerva timing side-channel on P-256 signing
findings.exposure: transitive via cosmpy and uagents-core (Agentverse/chat integration); zero direct imports in hub code; hub account signatures use Ed25519 via the cryptography package, not ecdsa; signing with this library happens on the agent side, not the server
findings.mitigation: no upstream fix exists; accepted risk with exposure documented; monitor for upstream release

dependencies.summary: 4 advisory hits, 2 packages, both transitive on the Agentverse integration side; no known-vulnerable package is on the booking/escrow money path; no direct hub imports of either package

results.internal_review: docs/reviews/2026-11-16-security-refresh.md (208 lines): full audit of the current surface (hub auth, MCP face, checkout, agent faces, escrow state machine, both agent servers) - verdict NO critical or HIGH findings (5 LOW + 8 INFO); all 14 findings of the 2026-09-09 review verified closed in code; refund/liveness guarantees untouched; key pre-real-money item: R1 gate /access token minting behind PoW (tracked)

zap.scanner: OWASP ZAP 2.16.0 daemon, spider from https://everlist.network/, maxChildren=30, 2026-11-16
zap.note: spider completed and URL list captured; alert export empty (session ended before alert persistence) - reported as 'no alert-level findings captured' rather than 'no vulnerabilities found'

dast_lite.scanner: install-free Python DAST-lite battery, isolated hub boot, 2026-11-16
areas: malformed JSON and binary bodies handled without 500s
SSTI/XSS/SQLi payloads handled without stack leakage
path traversal and CRLF attempts rejected

honesty_note: This is an automated-plus-review self-check, not a penetration test. ZAP active scanning was run only against an isolated local hub; prod received a passive spider only. Published as evidence of diligence and process, not as a security guarantee. The vulnerability disclosure channel (/.well-known/security.txt) is the live mechanism for external testing.
